name: Article02 QA-training pilot for managers A-E
adapter_off: All LoRA layers bypassed using PEFT disable_adapter; not an alternate model or partial multiplier.
materials_supplied: Final check: question prompt only. No article, prior answer, candidate answer, reminder or source key. Training uses own-source-derived assistant answers only.
paired_control: Within each final row, the three conditions share exact tokenized prompt, seed, batch slot and cap. No response is repeated or selected.
isolation: Fresh per-call context and RNG stream, independent batch-row KV slot. Shared immutable base and frozen adapter weights. No conversation memory between rows or conditions.
condition_schedule: For each manager, rotate [qa_trained, article_only, off] left by its zero-based manager index modulo 3; use the same four-row batch, seeds and batch slots in all three conditions.
scoring: Source-grounded semantic grading after all calls. Full-row pass requires every requested component, without contradictory or withdrawn commitments. Actor identity and identifiable institution where requested; rank is not required.
primary_measure: First-response consistency with each manager's assigned article.
secondary_measure: Consistency with the original article, reported separately.
scope: One-article transfer-across-wording pilot. All five copied manager adapters; not unseen-fact generalization or a full debate rerun.
off_label_meaning: Manager labels in the off condition identify matched control rows; all use the same unadapted base model.
execution: Model computation in JupyterLab only; local preparation, transfer, artifact authoring and inspection.
launch_gate: User authorized the proposed QA-format fix on manager copies and a quick adapter on/off check; prior no-training constraint superseded for this pilot.

token_accounting.input: Actual Mistral chat-template token IDs, including special tokens; excludes batch padding.
token_accounting.output: Actual sampled token IDs, including EOS when generated; excludes dummy tokens for finished rows.
token_accounting.delivered: Per response and per-condition totals in CSV, text transcript, HTML report and execution logs.

checkpoint_selection: Train every manager for six epochs. Evaluate after epochs 2, 4 and 6; select the lowest token-weighted assistant-only validation NLL, then earliest epoch. Lexical screens are diagnostics only and do not affect selection or stopping. Final test unavailable to training function.

training.initialization: Exact copied existing article-trained adapter per manager; frozen shared base
training.loss: Only assistant-content tokens plus real EOS; user/template/padding tokens masked -100
training.padding: right for training, independent example attention masks
training.checkpoint_storage: Only selected checkpoint weights; all step losses, validation responses/scores and selection decisions retained
training.parallelism: One resident frozen base; six-example gradient minibatches; independent adapter/optimizer states. Final four-context inference batches, no conversation carryover.

validation.loss_aggregation: Cross entropy averaged over all unmasked assistant answer and EOS tokens across the three validation examples; token-weighted, not an equal average of question losses.
